lines.t:
The state of a <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c> or <c:ffff00>{{object}}<c> that breaks when its
<c:ffff00>{{armor}}<c> reaches 0.

It can no longer perform <c:ffff00>acts<c> or <c:ffff00>responses<c>, and all
of its <c:ffff00>{{stats}}<c> are nullified. The {{armor}} of a destroyed
{{part}} can't be <c:ffff00>recovered<c>, but the <c:ffff00>{{restore}}<c> effect
works.
A <c:ffff00>{{medabot}}<c> whose <c:ffff00>head<c> is destroyed is <c:ffff00>{{knocked_out}}<c>.
A destroyed {{object}} disappears.
